scope: Remote execution, output bounds, duplicate prevention, and repository transport guidance. No hadith source or reader behavior changes.

observed_causes.conversation_limit: Repeated large encoded transfers and verbose results in the supplied history exhausted conversation context.
observed_causes.remote_connectivity: Device online; bounded terminal execution and completed process output retrieval passed.
observed_causes.recent_large_write: A prior write with 983172 characters of serialized arguments completed successfully; it was not evidence of a connector outage.
observed_causes.previous_browser_failure: Linux Chromium initialization failed with socket() and ptrace Operation not permitted, before a page could load.
observed_causes.authentication: Local Git read access worked but local Git push authentication was unavailable. GitHub connector blob writes succeeded and their returned object hashes matched local input. Credentials were not moved.

validation.windows_source_transfer: Runner and test-file SHA-256 matched their Linux source bytes.
validation.windows_repeated_invocation: Returned reused=true with the same job ID, process IDs, start time and finish time; no second test execution.
validation.large_output_regression: Two MiB in one line remained in output.log; the console summary was bounded.
validation.timeouts: Owned descendant termination and saved timeout status passed on both tested operating systems.

browser_runtime.runtime: Installed Chrome in headless mode with a separate task profile

limits: The runner records the last saved state; a missing final checkpoint requires inspection rather than automatic retry.
The browser smoke test verifies the replacement runtime only. Each bank import still needs its own rendered-page checks.
Conversation limits, external outages and source-command defects are not removed by this workflow.
